submitted.rationale: Highest measured EQE (0.00181%) of three measurements. XRD shows In2O3 bixbyite fading with Sb content and a rutile-type (InSbO4-like, Q≈1.87) phase appearing near 50:50; index 20 sits in the rutile-containing region and outperformed the bixbyite-rich index 8 (0.00151%), while the Sb-rich extreme index 27 was ~0.
